full_details.title: GoDaddy Email MX Configuration
full_details.full_description:
I recently purchased a domain and mailbox plan through GoDaddy, but the address is still not sending or receiving. I want every Titan-specific record—MX, SPF, and DKIM—added or corrected in the DNS zone, plus any stray entries from previous services removed. I am not sure if another mail platform is active in the background, so a quick audit of the zone file is part of the job.

Once the records are in place, please wait for propagation (or force-check) and confirm that mail flows both ways through Titan. I will provide temporary GoDaddy access immediately and need the whole task wrapped up ASAP.  

Deliverables  
• DNS cleaned and updated with official Titan MX, SPF, and DKIM records  
• Proof of successful send-and-receive tests  
• Brief hand-off note so I know what was changed and why
